translations.web: When they had appointed elders for them in every assembly, and had prayed with fasting, they commended them to the Lord, on whom they had believed.
translations.bsb: Paul and Barnabas appointed elders for them in each church, praying and fasting as they entrusted them to the Lord, in whom they had believed.
translations.kjv: And when they had ordained them elders in every church, and had prayed with fasting, they commended them to the Lord, on whom they believed.
translations.asv: And when they had appointed for them elders in every church, and had prayed with fasting, they commended them to the Lord, on whom they had believed.
